title: The Latest Crier for Mar 03, 2026
items:
ZY Sweets For Your Sweetie Fundraiser

Buy some Sweets for your Sweetie from Zeta Upsilon Feb 9-12, from 5-8 pm in the Maytag Atrium for only $3! You can choose between chocolate candies, fruit-flavored candies, or a mix to show how well you know your Sweetie!

Planning to stay in Pella this summer? Need a place to live?

Click here to find out more information about on-campus housing and fill out the summer student facility use contract. Space is limited so fill out the form and pay your first two weeks' rent by Wednesday, April 1st to reserve your spot. Contact Sarah Lunsford (lunsfords@central.edu) if you have any questions.

Green Careers Job Panel

Are you interested in a green career? Want to know more about working in a green career? 
Come to SCATE's Green Careers Panel Monday March 2nd at 8pm in VSC 180. 

We will have professionals from different careers (including Central College Alumni) to talk about what they do and how they got into their role. 

If you have any questions or want to know more reach out to Summer at Chamberss1@central.edu.

Central College Mission Statement

Central College Mission Statement Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

STUDENT TRUSTEE SPOTS OPEN!

Student Trustee Applications are OPEN NOW and due March 6th at 5pm 
What is a Student Trustee? 

- A non-voting representative to the Board of Trustees and the voice for students during important decision-making processes 

How do I apply? 

- The application can be found in your Central email from ssenate@central.eduIt or at MyCentral > Student Life > Student Senate 

Who are the current Student Trustees? 

- Parker Lawrence, Madison Craig, Elyse Shaw, Cassie Elliott, and Mya Ehresman

Pre-Health Students!

Grad Schools are coming in March!! 
Check your email for a Handshake invite to the Pre-Health info sessions on March 24 & 26. You will want to attend no matter when you graduate. Hear what the schools have to say during a Q&A time at 11:30 - then from 12-1 pm visit with the schools at their tables. 

Visit with Cyndi Boertje (Geisler - Room 261) if you are pre-health and you did not get an invite.

Language Placement Test

Students who need to take a Language Placement Test for Spanish or German can stop by the Vermeer Science Center (VSC), Room #241 from 11:00am-12:00pm on Tuesday, March 10th. Use the following link to add your name and select a time to confirm your attendance. Contact Dr. Ally Krogstad ( krogstada@central.edu ) or Prof. Oscar Reynaga ( reynagao@central.edu ) if you have any questions.

Summer Internship?

Let us know!! If your internship is non-credit for the summer, please give us the deets so we can help future students as they search for internships. It's a quick few questions in Handshake. 
If you want credits for your internship , meet with Cyndi Boertje to get all the information you need to get it in Handshake. 

Thank you!!

Learn About Scotland! March 10

Want to study abroad in Scotland? Shannon from University of Scotland will be here March 10. 
We will be in Maytag to talk from 11-1 pm. Cashen Thompson just returned from Scotland and Katelyn De Boer is there right now. Talk with them about what their semester looked like!

See what’s new at Pella Cinemas | Central Student Free Movie Night | Sunday, March 8

Check out the remodeled space, new seating options, and new concession offerings! Central students can enjoy a free movie for the 5:30, 5:45, or 6:00pm shows on Sunday, March 8th! Show your Central ID at the theater concessions to get your free movie ticket! NOTE: tickets and seating options are subject to availability!
